topic: Job interview roleplay: tell me about yourself

vars.staffOpen: Let's start easy. Tell me about yourself.
vars.learnerLine: I'm a designer. I've worked on shopping apps for three years, and now I'd love to grow here.
vars.staffReply: Nice and clear. So why do you want to join us?
vars.tip: present, past, future. Who you are, what you've done, and what you want next.

title: Tell me about yourself – job interview roleplay
caption: How to answer "Tell me about yourself" in a job interview
